easy.def: One stage of something that changes.
examples: The moon is in a new phase.
This is a new phase.
The first phase is done.

more.def: One of the steps or stages of something that changes over time.
examples: The moon goes through many phases each month.
A caterpillar is one phase in a butterfly's life.
The first phase of the project is finished.

easy.def: A tool you use to talk to people far away.
examples: The phone rang.
I talk on the phone.
Mom has a phone.

more.def: A device that lets you talk to people who are far away.
examples: I called my grandmother on the phone.
The phone rang, and my dad answered it.
She used her phone to take a picture of the rainbow.

easy.def: A picture taken with a camera.
examples: I took a photo.
The photo is pretty.
Look at the photo.

more.def: A picture made with a camera, either printed or kept on a device.
examples: I took a photo of the sunset.
Grandma has a photo of me on the wall.
The photo shows our whole family.

easy.def: A picture made with a camera.
examples: I took a photograph of my cat.
The photograph is on the wall.
This photograph shows our trip.

more.def: A picture taken with a camera.
examples: The photograph shows our family at the beach.
She hung a framed photograph of her grandmother on the wall.
The photograph captured the sunset in bright colors.

easy.def: A person who takes pictures with a camera.
examples: The photographer took our picture.
A photographer works with a camera.
The photographer smiled.

more.def: A person who takes photographs, often as a job.
examples: The photographer took pictures at the wedding.
A nature photographer waited for the deer.
The school photographer lined us up.
"In the park" is a phrase.
Say the phrase again.
The phrase is easy to learn.

more.def: A small group of words that go together but are not a whole sentence.
examples: "On the hill" is a phrase.
She repeated the phrase to learn it.
The poem has a lovely phrase about the moon.

easy.def: Having to do with your body.
examples: Running is a physical activity.
Exercise is good for your physical health.
He has a physical job.

more.def: Having to do with the body, or with real things that you can touch.
examples: Gym class is a time for physical exercise.
A broken arm is a physical injury.
A rock is a physical object, but a dream is not.
